reason: I want this for my son, because wandering scares me more than anything. But it's a company with no reviews yet, and I don't put a camera and GPS on him from a stranger's word. I'd wait until I've read real families' 30-day experiences in the support groups.
objection: Nobody has used this yet. Will the GPS and SOS actually connect when he's in a ditch or a parking lot, and will he keep it on, or will he pull it off in a week?
would_change_my_mind: Three or four families in my support groups posting honest reviews after a few months of use, saying it connected every time and their kid kept it on.
